page_title: OSA 4-2 BAR | Osasuna v Barcelona 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Raphinha (Barcelona) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.

90+6' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
90+6' Raphinha (Barcelona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+5' Pedri (Barcelona) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+5' Hector Fort (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+5' PENALTY APPEAL after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90+3' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle after Jules Kounde (Barcelona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
90+1' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90+1' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Raphinha (Barcelona).
90' 7 additional min. will be played.

89' 4 - 2 Ferran Torres slides a pass towards Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the top right corner. The score is now 4:2.
88' Marc Casado (Barcelona) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the right post.

85' 4 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Abel Bretones (Osasuna) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Inaki Pena just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 4:1.
85' That will be all from Sergi Dominguez (Barcelona) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Hector Fort.
85' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
84' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Jesus Areso and he is replaced by Nacho Vidal (Osasuna).
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Juan Cruz as he is replaced by Jorge Herrando (Osasuna).
84' Sergi Dominguez (Barcelona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

83' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Inaki Pena anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Osasuna.
83' The ball is cleared after Jesus Areso (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
81' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
81' Raphinha (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
81' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
80' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
77' Vicente Moreno decides to make a substitution. Bryan Zaragoza will be replaced by Abel Bretones (Osasuna).
77' Substitution. Ante Budimir makes his way off the pitch and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) comes on as his replacement.
76' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
72' 3 - 1 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Inaki Pena into the bottom right corner.
72' The attendance for today's match is 22322.
72' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is going to take the penalty!
71' Sergi Dominguez (Barcelona) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
71' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul after Sergi Dominguez (Barcelona) hacks down one of his opponents. It's a penalty for Osasuna!
70' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Gerard Martin is replaced by Alejandro Balde (Barcelona).
70' Here comes a substitution. Robert Lewandowski is given a rest as he is replaced by Marc Casado (Barcelona).
69' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
69' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.
67' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
67' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Barcelona earn a corner.

66' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom right corner, but Sergio Herrera makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
65' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ante Budimir. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
63' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Ante Budimir (Osasuna) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post.
61' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
60' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
59' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
59' Substitution. Pau Victor leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
59' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raphinha (Barcelona) replacing Pablo Torre.
59' The substitution is prepared. Ruben Pena (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ruben Garcia.
56' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pablo Torre (Barcelona).

53' 2 - 1 Sergio Herrera is stranded way out of his goal after his team loses possession and Pau Victor (Barcelona) has the simplest of tasks to shoot the ball into an empty net from distance. It’s now 2:1.
53' Great save! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Sergio Herrera.
52' A decent effort by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar.
51' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) brings an opponent down and Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game. Barcelona earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
48' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.

45+2' Sergio Herrera pulls off a fantastic save! Jules Kounde (Barcelona) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out.
45+2' Pedri (Barcelona) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
45+1' Pedri (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
45+1' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) finds free space in the penalty box and sends in a first-time shot. It's a poor effort which goes miles wide of the left post.

44' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Sergio Herrera. This effort really didn't trouble him.
44' Pedri (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
43' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Barcelona will take a corner.
42' Pau Victor (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sergio Herrera, who smothers the ball.
40' Pedri (Barcelona) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

40' Pablo Torre (Barcelona) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

39' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Barcelona have a free kick from a promising distance.
39' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
38' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
37' Some great controlled play and passing from Barcelona. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
34' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but Inaki Pena comes off his line to gather the ball.
31' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
28' 2 - 0 Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) beats the offside trap and bears down on goal. With just the keeper to beat he coolly shoots past him from the edge of the box.
27' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
25' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) attempts to feed Pau Victor with a chip pass, but Sergio Herrera reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
23' One of the players from Osasuna times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
22' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.

18' 1 - 0 A perfect lofted pass from Bryan Zaragoza finds Ante Budimir (Osasuna), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom right corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Inaki Pena had no chance of stopping that. 1:0.
17' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
16' Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Pablo Torre (Barcelona). It's a free kick to Osasuna, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
15' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
13' Pedri (Barcelona) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Ferran Torres, but Sergio Herrera displays great awareness to stop him.
13' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
10' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

9' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Osasuna win a corner kick.
9' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
8' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Barcelona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ferran Torres (Barcelona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
2' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
2' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Osasuna will have the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra will officiate today.
